upstream.api_mapping: Two original Boolean predicates over decoded valid UTF-8 Text of0..1024 bytes,with empty name false/empty value true. No trim,normalization or arbitrary-byte/unbounded Go-string compatibility. Required host preflight refuses missing/non-string/raw malformed or invalidUTF8/unpaired surrogate/decoded oversized input before Gooo. Uppercase names and edge SP/HTAB values retain HTTP/1.x predicate behavior. Original HeaderFacts12 is a separate importing diagnostic composition; no HTTP/2,authorization,sending,enforcement or production-safety claim. Oracle imports the actual whole pinned net/text packages; .txt files are byte-preserved source references,not an extracted oracle implementation.

dependency.purpose: Actual imported httpguts whole package reaches net/idna and text bidirule,transform,bidi,norm; not a replacement predicate.

source_reference_scope: Exactly the three original http/httpguts Go files and BSD LICENSE,retained as non-build .txt references. The original module sums bind complete dependency archives; these four references alone do not authenticate or implement the imported oracle. CI authenticates whole downloads,verifies before building and after offline readonly verification; linked build info must contain exact unreplaced net/text module pins.
domain: Decoded valid UTF-8 strings,each at most1024 bytes. Name/value empty supported. No Unicode normalization or JSON-spelling preservation; offsets and bad octets are byte diagnostics. Required raw host preflight has independent16384-byte request cap. Unsupported input is refusal,never a Boolean false/zero/sentinel extension.
